method_tool: DIAMOND v2.1.11 BLASTx vs NCBI RefSeq viral proteins
threshold_or_criterion: e-value ≤ 1e-10, ≥ 30% amino-acid identity, ≥ 50 aa alignment length

reference: Camacho et al., 2009; Fiamenghi et al., 2025

threshold_or_criterion: Medium-quality or higher, ≥ 1 viral hallmark gene, or detected provirus boundary
Evidence level ≥ 2, spacers ≥ 25 bp, matched by BLASTn-short at ≥ 95% identity over ≥ 95% of spacer length
≥ 10 RCA read pairs at ≥ 95% mean identity and ≥ 70% breadth of coverage on the shotgun contig
Kraken2 assignment to a non-viral taxon (in this cohort human or bacterial/archaeal), or CheckV host genes ≥ 1 with viral genes = 0
reference: Wood et al., 2019; Nayfach et al., 2021
